explication: Stakpak is a DevOps agent that runs locally, interactively or as an always-on autopilot, to investigate infrastructure and perform operational work under configurable guardrails. The main workflow is: a user starts a CLI or TUI session; the agent builds context, consults an AI provider, and uses tools to inspect or change the environment; session state and results are retained or delivered through configured channels. The graph also captures documented search, indexing, knowledge, and task-management capabilities. README claims guide unsampled feature branches; edges are limited to documented relationships and workspace structure.
